description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source test management tool. It manages the execution dashboard, initializing page settings, retrieving test plan and project context, handling user rights, and preparing data for rendering the execution interface. The file includes functions for argument parsing, rights management, UI setup, and context loading, indicating its central role in the execution dashboard feature.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves argument object containing test plan, project, build, and platform context settings from HTTP request, session, and database.

methods.name: initializeRights
methods.description: Creates an object of user rights related to executing test plans, including permissions for executing, deleting executions, editing notes, and modifying test cases.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares and returns the GUI configuration object, including form tokens, test plan, platform, build info, custom fields, and REST API parameters.

methods.name: getContextFromGlobalScope
methods.description: Extracts execution context settings such as build and platform IDs from session or request parameters, supporting page state persistence.
